title: Monterey's 17 Mile Drive Guided Electric Bike Tour, 3 hr
includes: Free street parking available on nearby Crocker Ave and Asilomar Ave (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult
All riders must sign a waiver
Minors must have a waiver signed by a parent or legal guardian (can be signed electronically)
Child rate applies only when riding tandem with a paying adult
Max combined rider/child tandem weight 350 lb.
A maximum of 25 people per booking
policies: Can be chilly along the Ocean, please dress appropriately
Subject to favorable weather conditions. If canceled due to rain, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Keep an eye out for sea lions, deer, harbor seals, and tide pools along this immersive coastal adventure. Explore the world-famous 17-Mile Drive on an electric bike — the best way to experience Pebble Beach’s stunning coastline, iconic landmarks, and oceanfront mansions. This 16-mile round-trip tour (approx. 3 hours) includes scenic photo stops and local stories at the Lone Cypress, Asilomar Beach, Point Pinos Lighthouse, and more.

Our top-rated guides — consistently praised in reviews as the best in the area — bring the route to life with their knowledge of history, wildlife, and native plants. One even holds a master’s degree in biology!

With over 50 models of electric bikes available, we welcome riders of all sizes and experience levels (min. height 4’10”, max. weight 400 lbs). Most of the route follows protected bike lanes or low-speed roads (25 mph). Riders 12+ can typically ride solo at a parent’s discretion. Non-cyclists can ride tandem with a parent on a cargo eBike.
